newsitem.title: USA: ELSXI stake raised by investor group.
newsitem.headline: ELSXI stake raised by investor group.

text.p: A group led by investor Peter Kellogg said Friday it raised its stake in ELXSI Corp to 8.9 percent or 430,500 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 62,000 additional shares of ELXSI between December 16 and 23 at $5.50 to $5.375 a share.
The group holds its stake for investment purposes. It previously held a 7.69 percent stake in the Greenwich, Conn.,-based restaurant chain owner.
